title: Singapore and Bali Honeymoon Bliss | City Romance to Tropical Retreat
highlights: Experience the perfect blend of modernity and tradition with the vibrant cityscape of Singapore and the cultural beauty of Bali.
Enjoy a visit to the Night Safari Zoo, the world’s first nocturnal zoo in Singapore, and encounter diverse wildlife in their natural habitat.
Get on a scenic river cruise in Singapore, and sail past iconic attractions like Marina Bay Sands SkyPark, Clarke Quay, and Singapore Flyer.
Soar above lush green landscapes on the famous Bali Jungle Swing, feeling the adrenaline rush as you take in panoramic views of tropical forests and rice terraces.
Admire the stunning Balinese architecture and serene mountain backdrop at Handara Gate, an iconic photo stop.
inclusions: Transfer from Singapore Changi Airport to Deluxe Hotel

know_before_you_go: Please depart on suggested timings to avoid any inconvenience.
GST is applicable to the tour cost.
Make sure that you meet the representative within 70 minutes of landing.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Visa assistance will be provided however charges are not included.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature are not included in the tour package.
International / Domestic flights are not included in the tour package.
Please note that Singapore has a strict policy against littering in public areas. Heavy fines are in place for those found littering.
Images are for representation purposes only.
Kindly do not carry any chewing gum as it is banned in Singapore and defaulters will be penalised.
Please note that jaywalking is not allowed in Singapore, if caught, fines will be imposed.
Eating and drinking on public transport is not allowed.
Singapore’s climate is commonly tropical and humid. It is advisable to carry light, comfortable clothes.
Smoking is not allowed until and unless you are in a designated smoking area.
While credit card payments are widely accepted in Singapore, it is recommended that you carry some cash for small purchases.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Tram Ride at Night Safari Zoo
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore! Upon arrival at the airport, get transferred to your hotel and check in. You can relax at the hotel for some time and later, in the evening, get ready to board your transfer to Night Safari Zoo, where you will enjoy a 45-minute tram ride, passing by seven unique zones and spotting various animals. Later, you will be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Singapore Night Safari Tickets with Tram Ride - [Open Dated] Singapore Night Safari  Admission with Tram Ride

days.title: Singapore City Tour | Singapore River Cruise Experience
days.desc: Today, board your transfer for a sightseeing tour of Singapore. Visit the iconic Merlion Park, the DNA-shaped Helix Bridge, and the vibrant Chinatown among other attractions. Later, in the evening, get ready for a Singapore River Cruise experience. Sail across the serene waters of the river as you marvel at the glittering skyline of Singapore, passing by famous attractions. After the cruise, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Universal Studios Visit
days.desc: In the morning, you will be transferred to Universal Studios for a day full of exciting activities and attractions. Experience thrilling rides across different themed zones like Hollywood, New York, and Ancient Egypt. Hop on roller coasters and enjoy a thrilling ride or watch 3D shows and live performances. Also, explore the mysteries of the Lost World zone or interact with your favourite characters in Far Far Away. Later, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Bali | Arrival in Kuta | Leisure Day
days.desc: Check out of your hotel and get transferred to Singapore Changi Airport. Take a flight to Bali (flight tickets not included). Upon arrival, board your transfer to the hotel in Kuta and check in. On this day, you can choose to relax or explore Kuta at your own pace. Shop for souvenirs at Kuta Art Market, unwind at Kuta Beach, or indulge in water slides at Waterbom Waterpark. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Kintamani | Bali Jungle Swing Experience
days.desc: In the morning, you will be transferred to the village of Kintamani, known for its scenic views of Mount Batur, an active volcano. Stroll through the Tegalalang Rice Terrace, visit the stunning Tegenungan Waterfalls, and enjoy views of Mount Batur from Kintamani Highlands. After this, experience the exciting Bali Jungle Swing and admire panoramic views of the lush forests below. Later, get transferred back to your hotel in Kuta for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, board your transfer for a sightseeing tour of Bali. Begin with a visit to the iconic Handara Gate, known for its picturesque backdrop of lush greenery. Then, visit the Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, a beautiful Hindu Shaivite Temple by Lake Beratan. Next, you will be transferred to the scenic Pura Tanah Lot Temple, situated by the sea. Later, get transferred back to your hotel in Kuta for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out of your hotel and get transferred to Ngurah Rai International Airport for departure. This is where your trip comes to an end. Have a safe journey ahead!
